Harmony Township has adopted ordinances which require all rental units be inspected once every 24 months. The purpose is to ensure that safe and livable conditions exist for the tenants occupying these units. Failure to schedule these annual inspections will result in the Township using its legal means to have these inspections performed. What is the Scope of a Property Maintenance Inspection?
